admins.loginLocationNote: Only sign-ins into the ministry you are viewing — the other ministry's sign-ins appear in its own panel. Precise device location is used when the admin allows the sign-in location prompt; otherwise it falls back to an approximate city-level IP estimate. "Ministry not recorded" covers super-admin shared-password sign-ins from before the ministry was logged — both ministries' passwords grant that same role, so there is no way to tell them apart, and they appear in both. (The leader and welcome-team passwords exist only for College & Young Adult, so those are classified there.)

dbBackup.title: Full backup (off-site)
dbBackup.desc: Whenever data changes, the whole database is dumped, encrypted, and shipped to Cloudflare R2 automatically (bursts of changes coalesce into one run per hour, and the weekly Sunday backup still runs). Run a backup now, download a stored one, or restore from here.
dbBackup.dispatched: Backup started (check progress in GitHub Actions)
dbBackup.restoreWarning: Restoring replaces ALL current data (members, attendance, settings, everything) with the backup's snapshot. This cannot be undone — make sure you have a recent backup before continuing.
dbBackup.privateKeyHint: Never stored — used only for this one restore request.

kakaoQr.title: Add on KakaoTalk
kakaoQr.how: Scan a code with your phone camera to save the contact; KakaoTalk then picks them up as a friend by phone number. The Kakao ID rides along in the contact's notes.
kakaoQr.noPhoneTitle: {{n}} without a phone number — nothing to scan

kakaoQr.footnote: KakaoTalk has no link that adds a friend by ID, so the code carries a contact with the phone number instead. For anyone it doesn't pick up automatically, copy the ID and search for it in KakaoTalk.

admin.dbBackupCurrentDesc: Whenever data changes, the full database is automatically encrypted and overwrites the one current backup in Cloudflare R2 (bursts coalesce into one run per hour, and the weekly Sunday 5 PM Pittsburgh run still happens). Its size and completion time update live above.
admin.dbBackupCurrentDescAdult: Adult Ministry has its own database, separate from College & Young Adult, so its backup runs completely separately too. It fires only when Adult Ministry data changes, encrypting just that data over a single current backup in its own Cloudflare R2 location (bursts are coalesced to once an hour, and the Sunday 5 PM Pittsburgh run covers it too). The College & Young Adult backup contains no Adult Ministry data at all.
admin.dbBackupRestoreWarningAdult: Restoring replaces all current Adult Ministry data (roster, attendance, roles, settings) with the backup's snapshot. College & Young Adult data is not touched at all — the two databases are separate. This cannot be undone — make sure you have a recent backup before continuing.

settings.dongsanLinksDesc_adult: One link per cell. It shows and records only that cell's meeting attendance — leaders never sign in.

sheetSync.title: Google Sheet sync
sheetSync.desc: Add the tabs of the Google Sheet the 동산 leaders fill in, and the server reads them on a schedule (about every 10 minutes while an admin has the panel open), recording both worship and 동산모임 attendance. One direction only: the sheet updates the app, never the other way round.
sheetSync.linkLabel: Google Sheet tab URL (copy it with that tab open)
sheetSync.groupHint: The sheet names 동산 but not 부서. When each term/부서 has its own tab, pick that tab's 부서; when one sheet mixes both (the summer combined sheet), pick 합동. The term you add it in is recorded as that tab's term.
sheetSync.shareHint: Share the sheet as 'Anyone with the link — Viewer' so the server can read it; edit access isn't needed. Several tabs of the same spreadsheet can be added — the #gid=… at the end of the URL is what picks the tab, so copy it with that tab open.
sheetSync.tokenHint: Only needed if you want edits reflected instantly — paste this into TOKEN in the sheet's Apps Script (scripts/sheet-sync/Code.gs) and the sheet will knock on every edit. Without it the server still pulls the sheet on a schedule. The address the script knocks on is below.
sheetSync.tokenRotated: New sync key issued — update the script in each sheet.
